segments.name: North America
segments.description: Designs, develops, markets and sells NIKE and Jordan brand athletic footwear, apparel and equipment in the United States and Canada.
segments.evidence: The Company's reportable operating segments for the NIKE Brand are: North America; Europe, Middle East & Africa ("EMEA"); Greater China; and Asia Pacific & Latin America ("APLA"), and include results for the NIKE and Jordan brands.

segments.name: Converse
segments.description: Designs, markets, licenses and sells casual sneakers, apparel and accessories under the Converse, Chuck Taylor, All Star, One Star, Star Chevron and Jack Purcell trademarks.
segments.evidence: Converse is also a reportable operating segment and operates predominantly in one industry: the design, marketing, licensing and selling of casual sneakers, apparel and accessories.

revenueModel.text: NIKE is paid by wholesale accounts, including independent distributors, licensees and sales representatives, and directly by consumers through NIKE-owned retail stores and digital platforms.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products through NIKE Direct operations, which are comprised of both NIKE-owned retail stores and sales through our digital platforms (also referred to as "NIKE Brand Digital") and to wholesale accounts, which include a mix of independent distributors, licensees and sales representatives in nearly all countries around the world.
